content.key_idea: This background figure contrasts LLM decoding parallelism strategies: standard serial decoding generates one token per iteration, batching parallelizes across multiple requests, and speculative decoding parallelizes across multiple tokens per request within one iteration.
content.reading_order: Top: LLM/decoder structure and its four kernel types (FC in orange, attention in green). Middle: serial decoding timeline generating x0-x4. Bottom: batching (multiple requests in parallel) versus speculative decoding (multiple tokens per request in parallel).

summary: This background figure (not a diagram of PAPI itself) explains the LLM decoding concepts PAPI is built around. Panel (a) shows an LLM as a stack of decoder layers, each containing four kernels: QKV Generation, Multi-head Attention, Projection, and Feed Forward Networks, with FC layers in orange and the attention layer in green. Panel (b) shows serial decoding: a Prefill step processes the prompt, then four Decoding iterations generate tokens x0 through x4 one at a time. Panels (c) and (d) contrast two parallelism techniques: batching runs decoding for multiple requests concurrently, while speculative decoding lets one request produce multiple tokens (shown as two token tiles) per iteration. Small yellow/green token-square icons and blue decoder boxes recur across all four panels.
summary_zh: 该背景图对比LLM解码的并行策略：(a) LLM由多个解码器层堆叠而成，每层含QKV生成、多头注意力、投影、前馈网络四种核；(b) 串行解码逐个生成token；(c)(d) 分别展示批处理并行解码与推测解码并行解码，后者单次迭代可生成多个token。
notes: Background figure explaining generic LLM decoding parallelism, not a diagram of PAPI itself (PAPI's own architecture is shown in Figure 5).
